note: APPLIED 2026-08-22 (additive/idempotent, DORMANT — no client flip). THE FULL COMPANION ROSTER, projected on the envelope so the blob-retire capstone can rebuild G.companions from the server. hr_perks_of carried only the EQUIPPED companion's {id,xp} (a pricing field); a client reconstruction reading only that would default every OTHER owned companion to level 1 and silently drop the roster on the first armed boot. §1 PROGRAMMATICALLY patches hr_state_of (pg_get_functiondef + guarded replace at the total_level anchor, NO-OP if present) to add ONE additive top-level `companions` object: {equipped: player_state.companion_equipped, owned: [companion:<id> unlock ids], xp: {companion_xp:<id> stat aggregates}}. It carries NO literal `create or replace function public.hr_state_of(` header, so it is NOT an HR_STATE_OF_CHAIN member and takes over no last-toucher role (same technique as 2026-08-22-rested-record.sql / 2026-08-27-bank-store.sql / 2026-08-28-client-state.sql). The starter 'fox' is owned by grammar (no unlock row — hr_companion_equip c_starter) so it is deliberately ABSENT from `owned`; the client unions it in. `xp` is empty until the companion-XP writer (b434, COMPANION_XP_SERVER_BACKED) is armed — an absent id reads 0 → level 1 base (the self-configuring default hr_perks_of uses). MOVES NO authority: ownership is still written only by hr_unlock_buy / hr_companion_equip, equipped only by hr_companion_equip, XP only by the accrual engine — this is a projection of state those RPCs already own. NO EDGE REDEPLOY (computed in hr_state_of from columns/rows the deployed engine already stamps; no accrual.js/core/data change, pack-edge hr-accrue --check unaffected). §2 self-check PROVED on production apply in an HRC22-rolled-back subtxn: fresh character reads null/[]/{}; after two unlock rows + XP rows + hr_companion_equip, equipped='raccoon', owned=exactly [raccoon,sparrow] (fox NOT leaked), per-id xp raccoon 5000/sparrow 120; zero residue. Client DORMANT: src/net/accrue.js reconcileCompanions rebuilds G.companions.{ownedIds,xp,equipped} under the capstone arm ONLY (companionAuthorityArmed → window.HearthriseCapstone.isBlobRetired); dormant it is a pure no-op, so the load path is byte-for-byte unchanged. Wired on the boot hr_load path via src/net/record.js settle() (the always-full envelope, since an idle hr-accrue never runs applyEnvelopeState) and on every accrue/switch/gold envelope via applyEnvelopeState. ensureCompanionState (src/legacy.js + src/features/companions.js) is fail-closed under arm (seeds an EMPTY roster, never a fox-reset, until the envelope populates it); awardCompanionXp is gated off under arm (server owns companion XP). NOT in ALSO_LINTED — it creates no public function and no grants (rested-record precedent), only patches hr_state_of's projection. Reversibility: additive — re-apply 2026-08-28-client-state.sql (restores the hr_state_of body without the companions key); an old client ignores the extra key. Real predecessors: 2026-08-20-companion-model.sql (player_state.companion_equipped + the companion:<id>/companion_xp:<id> row model), 2026-08-28-client-state.sql (the live hr_state_of body it patches). Graded by tests/companions-record.mjs (dormant no-regression, armed rebuild, fail-closed-before-envelope, equipped-safety) + its own §2 self-check.
